lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Check it out, guys.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Elysion developed a new high-tech radar.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: elysionnl.com/news/article=4938203

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Anchor,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: does this mean you're out of a job?

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Why would that be the case?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Isn't having a radar like... your thing?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: If this fancy new radar can outperform you,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: wouldn't that make you obsolete?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: They could end up outfitting the Admire

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: with one of these new radars and giving you the boot.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I won't allow that to happen.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: There's more to Anchor than her radar.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: She's a member of the Aegis Squad.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: She's not someone who can be so easily replaced.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: I'm so touched...
I can't believe my ears.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I never thought I'd live to see the day

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: when Helm would speak so endearingly of one of her squadmates.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: This feels awesome.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: don't act like this is our problem alone.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You have a personal connection with Ingrid.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: If this situation were to ever come to pass,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: surely you'd be able to help

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: grease the wheels a bit?

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Grease the wheels?!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: So now we're resorting to bribery?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Helm.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I thought you were against that kind of stuff, Helm.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Of course I am.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: But the Aegis Squad cannot stand divided.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: If greasing some palms

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: is what it takes to keep us together,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: then that's something I'm willing to do.
I'll have a talk with Ingrid.
I call Ingrid and speak to her about the latest radar technology.
Okay, done.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: You contacted her?

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: What'd she say?
The radar that was on the news isn't a military-grade radar like Anchor's.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Hm.
Apparently it's meant to detect certain resources only.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: We got ourselves worked up over nothing, hehe.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Still,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: that was a heartwarming display of solidarity for your fellow squadmates, Helm.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Yeah, totally!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: You've really been keeping our noses to the grindstone these few days,

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: so I thought you weren't too fond of us.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: I guess I had it all wrong.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: I'm touched.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: How come Helm isn't reading her messages all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: You don't think it's 'cause she's embarrassed, is it?
Helm? Are you there?
Helm is no longer replying.
